title: Robot maker AGIBOT nears new funding round at RMB 50 billion valuation
key_facts: Chinese robot maker AGIBOT is nearing completion of a new funding round of about RMB 1 billion to RMB 1.5 billion.
The round values the company at about RMB 50 billion, according to investors cited by Caijing.
AGIBOT was founded in 2023 and began preparing a Hong Kong listing in July.
An investor told Caijing the new financing would push the IPO beyond the end of 2026, citing a 120-day gap between pre-IPO financing and listing unless an exemption is granted.
AGIBOT reported revenue of RMB 1.05 billion for 2025.
quote_evidence: Chinese AI robot maker AGIBOT is nearing completion of a new funding round of approximately RMB 1 billion to RMB 1.5 billion, valuing the company at about RMB 50 billion, according to investors cited by Caijing.
AGIBOT declined to comment on the latest financing, valuation and IPO progress.
why_it_matters_hint: A humanoid robot maker's reported valuation shows how much money is chasing Chinese robotics, though the round is not confirmed.
notes: Short article; figures come from unnamed investors cited by Caijing and are unconfirmed by the company.
